simple.summary: גְּזֵרָה (gᵉzêrâh) means a desert (as separated) First listed occurrence: Lev 16 22.

definitions.full: H1509. gezerah גְּזֵרָה noun feminine separation — גְּזֵרָ֑ה אֶלאֶֿרֶץ Lev 16:22 (P) unto a land of separation , of the goat for Azazel; solitary land RV; 'cut off,' i.e. whence it would not readily find its ways back VB.
